name: Jubilee Metals Group PLC
source: CRON 20261122: H1 FY2026 column from Jubilee Metals Group PLC unaudited interim financial report, six months ended 31 December 2025, unit US dollars absolute, continuing operations only. The South African chrome and PGM operations were classified as discontinued and were sold on 31 December 2025, so this column is the Zambian copper business plus corporate overheads, the same continuing operations basis the FY2025 column already uses. Revenue 14,098,275 less cost of sales 11,022,038 equals the printed gross profit of 3,076,237; operating costs 7,261,416 give the printed operating loss of 4,185,179. Net finance costs 2,881,269 is finance costs 2,907,229 less investment revenue 25,960. Profit before tax 4,307,660 loss also carries a 855,005 fair value loss and the 3,613,793 profit on sale of the non-current assets held for sale, which the ten row schema does not hold. Loss before taxation 4,307,660 less taxation 413,616 equals the printed loss for the period from continuing operations of 4,721,276; the discontinued operations loss of 4,542,620 sits below it, so total loss for the period was 9,263,896. EPS is the printed basic and diluted loss per share for total operations of 0.34 US cents converted to dollars; continuing operations basic loss per share was 0.20 cents.
